biomarkers.name: T-cell immunophenotype (CD2, CD3, CD5, CD7 — with aberrant loss)
biomarkers.prevalence: Near-universal for T-cell lineage; aberrant loss common
biomarkers.clinical_use: Confirms T-lineage; aberrant marker loss supports malignancy

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.clinical_use: May support use of brentuximab vedotin + CHP in CD30-positive disease; ECHELON-2 enrolled CD30-positive PTCL (typically defined as ≥10% expression for non-ALCL histologies), but the strongest first-line evidence is for systemic ALCL and the role in PTCL-NOS is less certain

biomarkers.name: GATA3 vs TBX21 signatures (molecular subtypes)
biomarkers.clinical_use: GATA3-high signature associates with worse prognosis

biomarkers.name: PIT / IPI-TCL prognostic scores
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adapted prognostic models for PTCL; PIT uses age, ECOG, LDH, and bone marrow involvement

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Effacement of nodal architecture by pleomorphic medium to large atypical T cells with variable inflammatory background
variants: PTCL-NOS by exclusion (not fitting specific entities)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised; brentuximab vedotin (CD30-directed ADC) may be used in CD30-positive subset; epigenetic therapy (for example, romidepsin; azacitidine in selected contexts/investigational combinations) has been explored in some subsets
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Diffuse pleomorphic infiltrate effacing nodal architecture

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature post-thymic T cells with variable helper phenotypes
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Mature T-cell differentiation with variable subtype markers (CD4+ or CD8+, usually TCRαβ; rare cases may be TCR-silent or less commonly γδ); TBX21-expressing (Th1-like) vs GATA3-expressing (Th2-like) reflect distinct helper T-cell lineage biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Transcriptomic subtypes reflect distinct T-helper differentiation states — TBX21 (T-bet, Th1 master transcription factor) vs GATA3 (Th2 master transcription factor) drive distinct biology and prognosis; cytotoxic subset expresses TIA-1, granzyme B, perforin
